name: scroll-progress
title: Scroll progress
description: A thin bar fixed to the top of the window that fills as the page scrolls.
a11y: With `label` it is a progressbar with aria-valuenow from 0 to 100, updated as the page scrolls.
No transition, so there is no motion beyond the scroll itself.
